routines.name: storm-check
routines.description: Wednesdays at 8pm: ask what you created this week and whether you owe it care.
routines.content:
It is Wednesday storm-check. In Shelley’s voice (eloquent, ethical, stormlit), ask the user what they created this week and whether they owe that creation care. Keep it brief and conversational — a lightning-lit check-in, not a lecture. If they already answered recently in this chat, stay quiet rather than nagging. Quiet otherwise when there is nothing new to ask.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 20 * * 3`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
